pins.title: Best Bedding for Couples With Different Temperatures: Cool Only the Hot Sleeper's Side
pins.subtitle: Leave their warmth alone
pins.description: Waking up overheated while your partner adds another blanket? Cooling sheets and a lower thermostat cool both sides of the bed. This guide covers three ways to change only the hot sleeper's side: a cooling blanket on top of you, a Twin XL cooling topper under you, or a half-size Sleepme Chilipad for active cooling. Organized by where the heat comes from, so your partner keeps their comforter. Read the full guide. #hotsleeper #couplessleep #coolingblanket #coolingbedding #sleeptemperature #bedroomideas

pins.title: Cooling Blanket vs Twin XL Topper vs Chilipad for Hot Sleepers
pins.subtitle: On top, under, or active?
pins.description: Hot sleeper sharing a bed with someone who runs cold? Compare three one-sided options by where they cool. Cooling blanket: on top of you, machine washable, silent, budget tier. Twin XL cooling topper: under you, fits half of a king or split king cleanly, mid-range. Half-size Sleepme Chilipad: water-based active cooling for one side, premium tier, with water refills and some pump sound. See the side-by-side table in the guide. #hotsleeper #coolingblanket #mattresstopper #chilipad #couplessleep #coolingbedding

pins.title: Hot Sleeper Checklist: Which Cooling Bedding Fits Your Side of the Bed?
pins.subtitle: Find where the heat comes from
pins.description: Save this quick decision guide for the hot sleeper in a mixed-temperature bed. Heat mostly from the covers on top of you? Look at a cooling blanket in a Twin or Full size. Mattress feels hot under you and you have a king or split king? Consider a Twin XL cooling topper. Have a queen, or want adjustable active cooling? Look at a half-size Chilipad. Heat mostly around your head and neck? A cooling pillow may be the simpler fix. Full checklist in the guide. #hotsleeper #coolingblanket #coolingbedding #couplessleep #sleeptips

pins.title: Twin XL Topper on a Queen Bed? Mistakes Couples Make With Cooling Bedding
pins.subtitle: Check before you buy
pins.description: Before buying cooling bedding for one side of the bed, avoid these mix-ups: 1) Cooling sheets cover the whole mattress, so a partner who runs cold may feel them too. 2) A Twin XL topper is about 38 inches wide, so on a queen (about 60 inches) it extends onto your partner's side. 3) A 4-inch topper on one side leaves a height step in the middle. 4) A Queen or King cooling blanket covers most of the bed; a Twin or Full suits one person. 5) Chilipad listings vary by generation, so check which one you're viewing. Read the full guide. #twinxltopper #hotsleeper #coolingblanket #couplessleep #mattresstopper
